conventions.crps: Not computed. CRPS skill needs the null's distribution for the same date and the published artifact does not carry one.
conventions.independence: Consecutive nightly forecasts overlap almost entirely at every horizon beyond a day. Independent counts are thinned to non-overlapping windows, the same rule the backtest follows.
conventions.pit: Interpolated on the published five-point quantile grid, not computed against the simulated ensemble, because the artifact carries quantiles rather than paths. Coarser than the backtest's PIT and not comparable with it point for point. A realised value outside the grid is recorded as censored rather than clamped.
conventions.what_this_is: Forecasts this engine published to a public git repository before the outcome existed, scored after it did. This is not the walk-forward backtest and is never pooled with it: the backtest simulates what the engine would have said, and this records what it did say.
conventions.why_separate: Pooling would make this sample look testable years earlier than it is, by diluting it with observations that carry a weaker guarantee. The counts are reported apart so a reader can see exactly how much of the evidence is of which kind.

horizons.test_note: 1 independent windows against a threshold of 30 fixed in advance: no test is possible yet, and none is reported.
